_doc: Loading-screen and downed-screen tips (scripts/ui/tip_pick.gd). Each tip: id, text, and an optional 'when' trigger read from the last expedition's stats. {action} in a text becomes that action's key (Settings.key_cap). The most relevant unseen tip wins, else a random unseen one, else any. Tips that name the Blight are skipped when the Blight is off.

triggers.abyss: the last expedition ended with a fall into the abyss
triggers.no_summon: your Boki was never sent out
triggers.no_e: the E ability was never used
triggers.wisp_stolen: a rival took one of your Boki
triggers.blight: the Blight knocked you down or out

tips.text: Falling all the way into the abyss is death. Hold {glide} below the edge to catch an updraft back up, or touch the cliff to climb onto it.
Knocked off an edge? Touch the island's side and you float back up onto it.
Short of the ledge? Jump at a wall in the air to kick off it, then glide the rest.
Open your glider early when you jump off the skyship. A longer, slower fall means you land where you planned.
{throw} sends your Boki out. It stuns what it hits; press again to call it back.
Hold {throw} to give your Boki an order: chase, guard, return or follow.
Your Boki stuns or roots a foe? Shoot it right away for a combo.
Fight alongside your Boki to fill the bond meter, then {ultimate} fuses you for its bond ultimate.
{signature} is your hunter's utility ability. It recharges by itself, so use it every fight.
Open a fight with {signature}, then follow up with your weapon. Most kits chain the two.
Every weapon has its own right-click ability on {secondary}. Try them all in Training.
Hold {glide} (or {jump}) in the air to glide. You can open your glider off any booster too.
Hits don't knock you out of a glide, but they drain your glider twice as fast. Run it dry and you drop like a stone.
Dash in mid-air, then glide: you cross gaps a plain jump can't.
A rival took your Boki? You'll sense it when they're nearby. Take it back.
Whoever carries a stolen Boki walks slower and shows up marked. Run them down and take it back.
Go down for good and the Boki you brought are left behind. Old Pell's Black Market sells back the ones nobody claims.
The Blight hunts by noise and light. Gunfire, blasts, opened chests and dashing draw it in; sneaking with {crouch} doesn't.
The Blight starts weak and grows the longer your squad is out, the deeper you go, and at night. Leave before it catches up.
A Watcher's light sweeps the ground. Stay in it and it shrieks, and the Blight nearby comes running. Crouch to stay out of its reach.
Exits open partway through. Stand inside one to fly home with everything you carry.
You only see what's in front of you. Rivals behind you or past a wall stay hidden, and so do you.
Tall grass hides you from anyone outside it. Shooting gives you away for a moment.
Get knocked into a wall and you're stunned. Do it to them first.
Shots go exactly where you aim. Fast guns sway in the same small pattern every time, and firing slows your step.
One hit breaks a crate, pot or barrel. A red powder keg lights a fuse, then blows: get clear.
Weapons you find out here are stronger than your own, but only for this expedition.
Health and armor don't come back on their own. {util1} drinks a tonic, {util2} repairs your armor with a kit. You take more damage while you do either.
Gloves drop from chests, vaults and bosses. You carry one active glove ({gear1}) and one passive glove at a time; a new one replaces the old.
A teammate is down? Stand on their wisp to bring them back. Stand on an enemy's to stomp it, or hold {interact} to finish them.
Dash through a shot at the last moment and you take nothing.
